title: He Lived in an Airport for 18 Years #shorts
description:
Mehran Karimi Nasseri lived in Terminal 1 of Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport from August 1988 until July 2006. His documents were lost in 1988 (he said his briefcase was stolen; other accounts differ), and without valid papers he could not enter France or fly on. He turned down residency offers in 1995 and 1999 because the papers did not match his preferred name. The 2004 film The Terminal is described as loosely inspired by his story. A true story.

Question: could you live in an airport for a week? Tell me in the comments.

Made with AI assistance (research, voice and artwork). Events are simplified for storytelling.
